plan.title: Simplify task list item labels to show number and title only
plan.overview: Modify TaskItem label construction to display "{number}: {title}" instead of the full task slug. Extract the task number by splitting the task ID on the first hyphen character. This follows the same pattern used by QuickItem in quicks-view.capability.ts.

approach.rationale:
Following the existing QuickItem pattern at quicks-view.capability.ts:14 which displays `${quick.id}: ${quick.title}`. For TaskItem, the task ID contains the number prefix (e.g., "028-simplify-task...") so we extract just the number portion using split('-')[0].
This is a minimal change - single line modification in the TaskItem constructor. The zero-padding is preserved because it comes directly from the task ID string.

task.name: Update TaskItem label to show number and title
task.action:
- Modify TaskItem constructor at line 62 - Extract task number using task.id.split('-')[0] - Change label template from full ID to number only
Current code (line 62): ```typescript super(`${task.id}: ${task.title}`, vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.Collapsed); ```
Change to: ```typescript const taskNumber = task.id.split('-')[0]; super(`${taskNumber}: ${task.title}`, vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.Collapsed); ```
task.done: TaskItem displays "028: Simplify task list item labels..." instead of full slug
